title: 玉华州找工具
subtitle: 借用之前先问，归还之前先检查
origin: 《西游记》第八十九至九十回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 工具再有趣也不能擅自拿走；借用要说明用途、约定时间，并在归还前认真检查。
moral.en: No tool should be taken without asking. Borrowing means explaining the purpose, agreeing on a time, and checking it before return.

pages.zh: 玉华州练习课后，悟空、八戒和沙僧把三件工具放进有编号图案的工具房。
pages.en: After practice in Yuhua, Wukong, Bajie, and Sha stored their three tools in a picture-coded tool room.
pages.prompt: Wukong, Bajie and Sha safely place red-gold staff, rounded farm rake and broad round-edged spade into separate wall racks marked only with circle, leaf and moon picture icons; no text.

pages.zh: 第二天，工具房空了，只剩一撮金黄色的软毛和几片做灯笼的彩纸。
pages.en: The next day the room was empty, leaving only a tuft of soft golden fur and pieces of lantern paper.
pages.prompt: Full team and three Yuhua princes inspect three empty racks, one soft golden fur tuft and colorful blank lantern paper on clean floor; calm clue-finding, no text.

pages.zh: 悟空没有马上追人，先请大家核对借用簿。可今天的三个图案格全是空的。
pages.en: Wukong did not rush after anyone. He checked the borrowing board, but all three picture spaces were empty.
pages.prompt: Wukong and princes examine a wooden borrowing board with three clearly empty picture-icon spaces, no letters; Bajie and Sha preserve the scene, no text.

pages.zh: 彩纸来自城外的黄狮灯坊。大家找到那里，看见黄狮正用三件工具搭一座大灯架。
pages.en: The paper came from Yellow Lion Lantern Workshop, where Yellow Lion was using the three tools to build a large lantern frame.
pages.prompt: Friendly Yellow Lion craftsperson with soft golden fur, fluffy amber mane, cream muzzle, large brown eyes, indigo work tunic and saffron apron uses the three tools safely to assemble a rounded lantern frame; no fangs, claws or text.

pages.zh: 黄狮说想给长辈九灵爷爷一个惊喜，怕开口借不到，才趁夜里拿走。
pages.en: Yellow Lion wanted to surprise Elder Nine-Spirit and feared the request would be refused, so he took the tools at night.
pages.prompt: Yellow Lion lowers his head and honestly explains beside unfinished lantern; tools rest safely on floor while Wukong, Bajie and Sha listen without threatening poses, no text.

pages.zh: 九灵爷爷来到灯坊：“惊喜不该让别人担心。先问一声，我们也许还能一起帮忙。”
pages.en: Elder Nine-Spirit arrived. “A surprise should not make others worry. Ask first, and perhaps we can help.”
pages.prompt: Elder Nine-Spirit, a large gentle lion elder with soft ivory-gold fur, nine small rounded cloud-like mane tufts, kind teal eyes, sage-green robe and wooden bead bracelet, speaks warmly; no extra heads, fangs or text.

pages.zh: 黄狮道歉后，大家重新登记借用时间，一起检查手柄、齿口和固定扣。
pages.en: After apologizing, Yellow Lion registered the borrowing time, and everyone checked handles, rounded teeth, and fasteners together.
pages.prompt: Yellow Lion, team and princes place sun-and-moon picture tokens on borrowing board and inspect each tool on padded benches; safe maintenance, no readable text.

pages.zh: 大灯架顺利亮起，三件工具也准时归位。黄狮学会：先征得同意，合作会让惊喜更圆满。
pages.en: The great lantern glowed, and all three tools returned on time. Yellow Lion learned that permission and teamwork make a surprise better.
pages.prompt: Beautiful rounded animal-shaped lantern frame glows safely with covered lights as Yellow Lion, Elder Nine-Spirit, full team and princes celebrate; three tools visibly returned to racks, no text.
